title: PMRecBench: A Benchmark for Personalization in Recommendation Agents under Multimodal Queries
abstract: arXiv:2611.06349v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On Web platforms for shopping and entertainment, recommendation agents under multimodal queries aim to deliver personalized recommendations that satisfy users' visually specified requirements and reflect preferences inferred from user histories. However, existing personalized recommendation benchmarks use text-only queries, while multimodal ones assess query matching without evaluating personalization based on real user histories. We introduce the Personalized Multimodal Recommendation Benchmark (PMRecBench), the first benchmark to evaluate the personalization of recommendation agents under multimodal queries. It pairs 510 quality-controlled image-text queries across clothing and movies with the corresponding users' real histories. translated_title: PMRecBench：面向多模态查询下推荐智能体个性化的基准测试
translated_abstract: 在购物和娱乐类Web平台上，多模态查询下的推荐智能体旨在提供满足用户视觉指定需求、并反映从用户历史中推断出的偏好的个性化推荐。然而，现有的个性化推荐基准仅使用纯文本查询，而多模态基准只评估查询匹配，并未基于真实用户历史来评估个性化能力。我们提出了个性化多模态推荐基准PMRecBench，这是首个评估多模态查询下推荐智能体个性化能力的基准。该基准将涵盖服装和电影领域的510个经过质量控制的图文查询与相应用户的真实历史记录相配对。PMRecBench具有两个关键设计：(1) 查询来源于真实用户记录中一致的行为模式，参考图像和目标均与实际交互相关联；(2) 具有挑战性的诊断性设计
tldr: 提出了首个评估多模态查询下推荐智能体个性化能力的基准PMRecBench，通过将510个来源于真实用户行为模式的图文查询与用户真实历史配对，填补了多模态推荐评估中缺失个性化维度的空白。
en_tdlr: PMRecBench is the first benchmark to evaluate personalization in recommendation agents under multimodal queries, pairing 510 quality-controlled image-text queries derived from real user behavior patterns with actual user histories across clothing and movie domains.
